title: How Long Do You Have Left To Live?
summary: Routine, food, movement, sleep, stress and recovery shape a playful AI lifestyle prediction.

landing.intro: Answer these questions and AI will predict how long you have left to live.

startPrompt.title: Your lifespan estimate is ready to begin
startPrompt.copy: Watch one short ad, then answer the questions.

about.body:
This five-round quiz uses familiar lifestyle clues—including routine, food, movement, sleep, stress, social connection, daily choices and recovery—to create a playful years-left estimate and personality-style result. Its 40 interactions are deliberately varied, so it feels more like an unfolding AI lifestyle scan than a health questionnaire.

Each round explores a different part of everyday life, then reveals how far the prediction journey has progressed. The final prediction choice provides only a restrained calibration, so it cannot determine the displayed estimate on its own.

The quiz does not use medical records, clinical research, family history, current age, healthcare data or an individual risk assessment. The displayed estimate is a playful quiz mechanic based only on the choices made during this attempt.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Choose the lifestyle answer that feels most like you without overthinking it.
Complete each eight-question round to reveal the next part of your prediction journey.
Finish the final calibration to reveal your playful AI estimate and profile.

about.disclaimer: This quiz is for fun and self-reflection only. It does not predict your lifespan, health, future, mortality risk or medical outcomes. If you have health concerns, speak to a qualified healthcare professional.

profiles.title: Centenarian Energy
profiles.copy: Your answers give off steady-habit energy: small joys, a bit of movement, and a surprising talent for choosing the sensible option without making life boring. You make consistency feel natural rather than strict.

profiles.title: The Steady Long Game
profiles.copy: Your answers point to a slow-burn lifestyle: practical choices, decent pacing, and the kind of everyday consistency that makes your future self quietly grateful. You tend to choose progress you can actually sustain.

profiles.title: The Balanced Realist
profiles.copy: Your answers suggest a grounded mix of sense and fun. You know life is not a wellness brochure, but you also know when a small choice keeps things smoother.

profiles.title: Weekend Chaos Mode
profiles.copy: Your answers have bright, chaotic, “this became a story” energy. You may not always choose the tidy path, but you bring spark, humor, and momentum.

profiles.title: The Stress Sprinter
profiles.copy: Your answers point to deadline-fuelled energy: fast, capable, and occasionally powered by pure suspense. Your best upgrade is pacing, not panic.

profiles.title: The Comfort Creature
profiles.copy: Your answers lean familiar, low-drama, and comfort-loving. You know the value of ease, and your sweet spot is soft living with just enough fresh air.

profiles.title: Adventure Fuse
profiles.copy: Your answers have restless, curious, say-yes energy. You are drawn to novelty, stories, movement, and the feeling that a normal day could still become memorable.

profiles.title: Reset Needed
profiles.copy: Your answers suggest your system is asking for a reset: fewer tiny fires, more breathing room, and a rhythm that lets you feel like a person again. Very fixable. Very relatable.

reviewUnlock.title: Unlock what shaped your result
reviewUnlock.copy: See each choice you made and whether it raised, lowered or kept your estimate neutral.
reviewUnlock.adNote: Short ad first — then your choice-by-choice breakdown unlocks.
reviewUnlock.raisedCopy: This choice added an upward lifestyle signal to the estimate.
reviewUnlock.loweredCopy: This choice added a downward lifestyle signal to the estimate.
reviewUnlock.neutralCopy: This choice added context without moving the estimate meaningfully either way.

details.analysisCopy: Your choices were compared across routine, food, movement, rest, stress, connection, activity and recovery. The final prediction answer provides only a small calibration, so one optimistic or cautious choice cannot determine the result by itself.
details.roadmapIntro: Your estimate was built in four clear steps:
roadmapItems: Everyday habits were grouped into lifestyle signals.
Rest, pressure and recovery patterns were compared.
Activity and social-connection choices shaped the profile.
The final calibration was applied within a limited range.
details.positionCopy: The marker shows where your result sits inside this quiz’s possible 73–95 range. It is a playful output from this attempt, not a prediction of lifespan or health.
details.measuredIntro: The quiz combines several everyday themes instead of letting one answer dominate:

measuredAreas.title: Daily rhythm
measuredAreas.copy: Routine, food and movement choices describe the pace and consistency of an ordinary day.

measuredAreas.title: Energy and connection
measuredAreas.copy: Activity and social choices add context about momentum, enjoyment and time with other people.

measuredAreas.title: Pressure and recovery
measuredAreas.copy: Sleep, stress, habit consistency and bounce-back choices shape the recovery side of the profile.

details.tipsIntro: These are not medical recommendations—just simple ways to think about the lifestyle pattern behind your result:

tips.title: Keep the repeatable wins
tips.copy: Notice which positive choices already feel easy enough to repeat without turning life into a strict routine.

tips.title: Make recovery realistic
tips.copy: Think about the smallest change that would make sleep, stress or recovery feel a little less chaotic.

tips.title: Leave room for enjoyment
tips.copy: A sustainable rhythm can include comfort, novelty and fun rather than treating them as the enemy of consistency.

details.finalCopy: This attempt produced an estimate of {age} years old and the profile “{profile}”. The value reflects only the answers selected in this quiz and should not be treated as health or life-expectancy information.

estimate.disclaimer: For fun and self-reflection only — this isn’t a medical or life-expectancy prediction.
